about: Unity Engineering fabricates pharmaceutical, chemical and industrial process equipment in Ankleshwar, Gujarat. Established in 2006 and owned by Niraj Kumar Shah, the business focuses on equipment configured around customer-specific process and fabrication requirements.
Process duty, operating conditions, maintenance access and material compatibility inform the equipment configuration. The design basis is agreed with the customer before fabrication proceeds.
manufacturing: A proposed fabrication workflow for process equipment. Activities and responsibility are agreed for each project.
Drawing preparation, material selection, marking and cutting establish the fabrication basis.
Plasma cutting, plate rolling and dish end forming prepare parts for shell, limpet coil, jacket and nozzle fabrication.
Fit-up, welding and machining are coordinated with agitator, shaft and housing assembly where required.
Surface finishing, buffing, polishing, inspection, testing and final assembly precede dispatch as agreed in the project scope.
infrastructure: The business operates from Plot No. 5122, 4th S Rd, Ankleshwar GIDC, Ankleshwar, Gujarat 393002, India.
Discuss site interfaces, equipment envelope, handling and dispatch constraints at enquiry stage. The project scope defines fabrication activities and facilities required.
quality: Quality begins with the design basis.
Inspection and acceptance requirements depend on the equipment duty and approved project specification.
Review operating conditions, materials and interfaces before finalizing drawings.
Agree dimensional checks, finish criteria, test requirements and documentation with the customer.
Confirm equipment configuration and project handover requirements before dispatch.
industries: These are relevant industrial applications for the equipment families in the Unity Engineering catalogue.
Reactors, vacuum dryers, filtration equipment and granulation systems support formulation and intermediate processing.
Chemical Industry · Fine Chemicals · Specialty Chemicals
Temperature-controlled reactors, process vessels and separation equipment are selected around reaction and handling requirements.
Heat exchangers, condensers, receivers and process columns support utility, containment and separation duties.
Storage tanks, blenders and mixers support compatible liquid, powder and paste-processing duties.
privacy: The website does not store submitted form entries. Form values are used in your browser to draft an email or WhatsApp message. Your chosen service receives the information when you continue through that service.
If you send an enquiry, the company receives the contact and project information you choose to share and may use it to respond or follow up.
The site does not use analytics or advertising trackers. The hosting provider may process technical request data to deliver and protect the website.
